description: Get or set session preferences for language, node URL, and node type. Language affects field name casing (TypeScript=camelCase, others=snake_case) and code examples.

language.description: For set: preferred language. Affects field name casing in lookups (TypeScript=camelCase, others=snake_case) and code examples.

node_url.description: For set: WebSocket endpoint for generated code

preferences.description: Preferences handle from subtensor_preferences(action="set"). Carries language/node_url/node_type without a session. Explicit arguments on this call take precedence over the handle.

name: subtensor_preferences

preferences_handle.description: Pass back as `preferences` on later calls to reapply these.

title: Session preferences
